title: Algerian Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Algerian stew made with potatoes and a blend of herbs. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the algerian spice mix and tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the herbal tea and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the crumbly goat cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve with a side of crusty bread or couscous, if desired.
